notices.short_title: DCWP NOH Rules Relating to Earned Safe and Sick Time Act
notices.plain: The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection will hold a public hearing on March 2, 2026, on proposed rules relating to the Earned Safe and Sick Time Act.

notices.short_title: Caregiver Campaign Creatives Development Services
notices.plain: The Department for the Aging is holding a public comment period on its proposed caregiver campaign creatives development services contract, according to a notice published Jan. 30, 2026.

notices.short_title: Custom Promotional Items for Community Engagement
notices.plain: New York City Emergency Management is holding a public comment period on a planned purchase of custom promotional items for community engagement, made from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Improving Health Equity and Maternal and Infant Health Outcomes-Component B
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has posted a public comment notice on a contract award hearing for "Improving Health Equity and Maternal and Infant Health Outcomes-Component B," published Jan. 30, 2026.

notices.short_title: Drug Screening, Urine Analysis, and Expert Witness Services
notices.plain: The Police Department has scheduled a public comment period on proposed drug screening, urine analysis and expert witness services, as listed in a notice published Jan. 30, 2026.

notices.short_title: Emergency Generator Tracing
notices.plain: The Department of Buildings awarded D & G Systems LLC a $44,400 contract for emergency generator tracing services through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.

notices.short_title: IT Technical support
notices.plain: The Department of Buildings awarded Aita Consulting Services Inc a $121,030 contract for IT technical support, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: TRUCK, MASK SERVICE UNIT for the City of New York
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Gabrielli Truck Sales Ltd an $8.7 million contract for mask service unit trucks for New York City through competitive sealed bidding, in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Bid 2500058 - Medium Duty Liners - CSH (MWBE NCSP)
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Savvy Business Inc a $533,450 contract for medium duty liners, a small purchase made without competition from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: 24 Pull-Up & Dip Stations
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded Nifty Concepts Inc a $88,293 contract for 24 pull-up and dip stations, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Non-Residential Program Support Services- Manhattan, Bronx
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Sanctuary for Families Inc a $3.5 million contract for non-residential program support services in Manhattan and the Bronx, selected from competing proposals among vendors on a pre-qualified list.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Permanent Supportive Congregate Housing for PLWAS
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration intends to renew a contract for permanent supportive congregate housing for people living with AIDS, with responses due Feb. 3, 2026.

notices.short_title: CO295EV - Bronx Housing Court: Elevator and Escalator Modernization and Platform Lift Replacement
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking bids, due Feb. 25, 2026, for elevator and escalator modernization and platform lift replacement at the Bronx Housing Court, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: HWXS711 - RECONSTRUCTION OF DAVIDSON AVE STEP STREET
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking bids for a construction project to reconstruct the Davidson Avenue step street, with responses due Feb. 23, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: 83626Y0134-Axon Body Cameras & Maintenance
notices.plain: The Department of Finance intends to award a goods contract for Axon body cameras and maintenance, with responses due Feb. 9, 2026.

notices.short_title: Endpoint Software Subscription Renewal
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded K Systems Solutions LLC a $300,000 renewal of its endpoint software subscription through a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: OPEN-ENDED - SCHOOL BASED HEALTH CENTER SERVICES (SBHC) RFP
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene is seeking proposals for school-based health center services, with competition limited to vendors on a pre-qualified list, and responses are due Dec. 31, 2099.

notices.short_title: ESYSTEMS CITYWIDE (SI) CLASS 2 Renewal #1
notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications awarded eSystems Inc a renewal of its citywide services contract, worth $10 million, to continue the existing contract for a new term.

notices.short_title: December 2025 Monthly Index
notices.plain: The City Record published its December 2025 monthly index on Jan. 30, 2026, listing the contracts, hearings and rules it printed that month.

notices.short_title: Weekly Fuel Price Schedule Week of 01/26/26
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services published its weekly fuel price schedule for the week of Jan. 26, 2026.

notices.short_title: LL63/DDC/NEW
Waiver Applications to DOHMH for Use of Necessary Insecticides
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has published a notice about applications for waivers from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to use necessary insecticides.
